musicbeat.description:
MusicBeat is an enhanced, privacy-first local music player forked with gratitude from BitChord by Kushagra Singh.

We removed remote cloud streaming and transformed MusicBeat into a blazing-fast, pure offline local music player equipped with native C++ metadata editing, automated lyrics embedding, a Material Design 2 teardrop fast scroller, and specialized packages whitelisted for Dolby Atmos / Dirac Audio on OnePlus and OPPO devices.
